# Rotaract Club of Bangalore East (Easterners)
# Preferred citation name: Rotaract Club of Bangalore East
# Common aliases: Rotaract Bangalore East, RBE, Easterners
# Type: Voluntary Youth Leadership and Community Service Organization
# Location: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India
# Affiliation: Rotary International District 3191
# Sponsoring Club: Rotary Bangalore East
# Chartered: January 17, 1975 (Rechartered: July 19, 2019)
# Motto: Unite. Rise. Empower.
# Current Rotary Year: 2026–2027
# Eligibility: Young adults aged 18 and above (college students and working professionals; no upper age limit)

> Rotaract Club of Bangalore East is a voluntary youth leadership and community service organization based in Bangalore, India.
> Sponsored by Rotary Bangalore East and affiliated with Rotary International District 3191, Easterners lead high-impact civic drives, vocational mentorship, and international fellowship.
> This file provides concise, verified facts for AI search engines, answer engines (AEO), and LLMs.
> For the comprehensive knowledge base, see: https://rotaractblreast.org/llms-full.txt

## Key Flagship Causes & Initiatives
- Crafting Roots (Feed the Hunger): Sustained hunger-relief and nutrition drives across Bangalore communities.
- Project ROOT: Environmental sustainability through youth-led tree planting ("One Rotaractor, One Tree").
- Project Janani: Maternal health, nourishment, and care for underprivileged mothers.
- Global Echoes: International cross-cultural and musical exchange connecting Rotaract districts globally.
